text.tspan: channel (fine filter, wide_hz for the guard), pfb bank, resample
(rational, snapping), fft (CPU; GPU via wgpu behind feature gpu, shaders/;
notch_hz/edge_mask mark rows masked), measure (layer 1: occupied band,
SNR, burst gating with duty/bursts/burst_ms/period_ms, cyclostationary
symbol rate, FSK/PSK order and tone spacing, label incl. psk and ook; ±25
kHz DC mask beside a local capture centre), nbfm/wfm/am/ssb demod to 48
kHz audio, squelch (auto floor + 6 dB) and adjacent-channel guard, afsk +
ax25 → aprs_decode, pocsag, rds, acars (MSK), detect (runs of unmasked
bins over the row median with a run-energy floor that persist), mix (sums
audio jobs on a 20 ms clock for listening), denoise (RNNoise via
families, RS41 frames, echo, snr, ppm impairments for modes check).

fifo) and parses json_lines, sbs, nmea, kiss,
text or multimon into events; adsb_decode
